definitions.gloss: the way there; outbound route; the route going to a destination
definitions.explanation: The route or journey taken when going to a destination, as opposed to the return trip.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{道|みち}でコンビニに{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped at a convenience store on the way there.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{道|みち}は{電車|でんしゃ}で、{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}はバスにした。
examples.english: I took the train on the way there and the bus on the way back.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{道|みち}に{見|み}かけた{花屋|はなや}で、{帰|かえ}りに{花|はな}を{買|か}おうと{思|おも}った。
examples.english: I saw a flower shop on the way there and decided to buy flowers on the way back.

notes:
USAGE:
The counterpart is {帰|かえ}り{道|みち} (the way back / return route). A common everyday word used when describing what happened during a journey to somewhere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {行|い}き{道|みち}に (on the way there)
- {行|い}き{道|みち}で (during the trip there)
- {行|い}き{道|みち}と{帰|かえ}り{道|みち} (the way there and back)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}: the way back — the return route
- {往路|おうろ}: outbound route — more formal, used for flights and transportation
